lines: The moment I saw the view, the girl in her swimsuit let out an excited cry.
Miyamoto Rei
Whoa! It's amazing! This resort pool is even more upscale than I expected!
Rei
Fuuma, you really found a hidden gem, didn't you?
Me
Well, it was Rei's request. I did my best to contact various places.
Rei
Aha. Just as I'd expect from my escort. You're so reliable!
The girl laughed as she said that.
Her name was Miyamoto Rei.
She was a girl from another world who had been summoned to this one, along with countless zombies, through the "Gate to Another World" that appeared in this city.
Rei
I brought weapons just in case, but it looks like we didn't need them.
Me
Yes, it seems the 'things' in this city have been completely wiped out.
Rei
I know. I heard that much. But given my past, I couldn't relax without something on hand.
Rei gave a wry smile as she spoke.
In her hand, clad in a swimsuit, she gripped a crude anti-zombie spear.
The contrast was quite surreal and amusing, especially since her swimsuit was so cute and sexy.
Me
I understand. It's always better to be on guard.
Rei
Right? Maybe you could turn into a werewolf and attack me.
Me
Huh? Rei, you were wary of me too?!
That was a bit of a shock.
Considering we had fought side by side against zombies and demons.
Rei
Aha! Just kidding, just a joke! I trust you! Anyway, let's get in, shall we?
Me
Y-yes, let's...
Rei laughed and headed toward the pool.
Originally, she should have already returned to her own world.
Yet now, here she was, with me, her "escort," on a poolside that was completely empty and private.
The reason for that was...
One day prior.
It was right after we had defeated the Brainlayer demon guarding the "Gate to Another World."
Rei
Huh...? Could you wait a little before we head back?
Me
Yes. I just received word from Professor Asagi, our superior.
Me
She wants to hear about the ecology of "those things" and the world Rei and the others come from.
I explain this to the three of them.
Rei and the others were summoned from another world where "those things" walking dead had appeared, and arrived in this world.
To return to their original world, they cooperated with our Taimanin unit,
reached the "Gate to Another World," the source of the incident, and defeated the demon guarding it.
With this, our mission is complete, and Rei and the others can safely return to their world.
That was the plan, until we received a message from Professor Asagi, our superior.
Me
It seems the demon we just defeated and the dead had a much deeper connection than we thought.
The moment the Gatekeeper demon fell, the zombies stopped moving. No, they actually just vanished.
Me
Furthermore, the energy reaction from the "Gate to Another World" has disappeared, so the danger is almost entirely gone at this point.
Me
So, she wants to delay the destruction of the "Gate" for a few days to conduct an investigation and take statements from you all.
That was the message from Professor Asagi.
Reproduced Saya
Umm, you're telling us this out of the blue...? We were fully prepared to go home.
Saeko
Right, we have comrades waiting for us back there. We don't want to stay in this world for long.
Saya and Saeko make faces showing they are not keen on the idea.
Me
Yes, I understand that. So if you three want to leave immediately, I won't stop you.
Me
However, we would like to thank you for your cooperation, so we will do everything we can for you.
Me
For example, a delicious meal or a warm bath.
Three People
The three of their eyes glinted at my words.
That was the story from one day ago.
Rei and the others agreed to delay their return for a few days,
and I was assigned to be their escort during that time.
Rei
Ahaha, it's so cold and refreshing! Tell me, you feel it too, right? Come on, come on!
Me
U, ugh! Hey, Rei, please don't splash water at me!
Rei
Fufufu, I refuse. If you're upset, why don't you hit back?
Me
Hmph! You asked for it. Then... here I come!
Rei
Kyaa! Ahaha! Yes, yes, that's the spirit!
Rei, drenched in the pool water, laughed innocently as the water splashed around.
This was the pool on the top floor of a hotel located in a corner of the collapsed city.
Rei
Since we were delaying our return anyway, I wanted to do things we couldn't do back there. It's this kind of season, so swimming in a pool!
Responding to Rei's request, I, as the escort, struggled to secure the rooftop pool of the hotel,
and after arranging the power and water supply, I managed to prepare an environment where we could enjoy ourselves.
Rei
Mmm, this is the best! Breathing freely under the sun... humans really need this!
After a long stretch of harsh survival, she had probably forgotten how to play in a pool.
Rei, bouncing around in her swimsuit, wore a beaming smile.
Me
Well, I'm glad. If you're this happy, then all my hard work was worth it.
Rei
Yes, thank you so much! You must have worked hard cleaning up, right? Given the state of the city.
Me
Yes. This hotel had been occupied by "them" and torn to shreds by the zombies.
Me
In fact, the entire rooftop was a mess.
I managed to restore the devastated pool facilities to a usable state.
Rei
I see. You've worked so hard, Fuuma...
Rei
Wait, hold on? I just realized something.
Me
What is it?
Rei suddenly made a disgusted face.
Rei
If the rooftop was a mess... does that mean "they" were soaking in the pool water too?
Rei
I've been drenched in water that's been in contact with "them"...?
Me
I-I'm fine! I think...
Me
It's true that a few corpses were floating in this pool too, but...
Me
I made sure to clean it thoroughly and replace all the water! So it's fine! ...Probably.
Rei
P-Probably? You...? Hmph, well, it's fine.
Rei laughed with a resigned expression.
Rei
There's no point in worrying about such things now.
Rei
We're used to "them" by now, and since they look this clean, there's no problem. Let's enjoy the pool!
Me
Haha, you're right, Rei!
